column3: Trust and permission boundaries are not identified.
column4: Trace where untrusted data enters and where authorization decisions are made.

column3: Authorization or tenant isolation is wrong.
column4: Follow each new access path and check that authorization and isolation are checked before the effect.

column3: Injection into queries, commands, templates, or HTML.
column4: Trace external data to queries, commands, templates, and markup and check it is parameterized or escaped.

column3: Path traversal, symlinks, or unsafe temporary files.
column4: Check that paths from input are confined, symlinks are handled, and temporary files are created safely.

column3: Unsafe requests, deserialization, or parsing of untrusted input.
column4: Check that URLs, serialized data, and parsed input from untrusted sources are restricted and validated.

column3: Secrets in code, logs, or reports.
column4: Look for credentials, tokens, and keys in the diff and in what the code logs or reports.
Review the cryptographic libraries, session handling, and default settings the change uses.

column3: A vulnerable dependency or uncontrolled install script.
column4: Check the added dependencies against advisories and look for install or build scripts they run.

column3: Tests or scripts perform unexpected actions.
column4: Read the commands the change adds to tests and scripts and check they act only within the project.

column3: Untrusted content reaches a model's instructions.
column4: Where the change passes external content to a model, check it is kept apart from instructions.

column3: A caller gains privileges it was not granted.
column4: Look for paths where identity or permissions can be changed without authorization.

column3: An untrusted plugin, server, or supply-chain component is added.
column4: Check that new plugins, servers, and components come from a known source at a pinned version.
Look for evaluation, dynamic loading, or shell execution of data that crosses a trust boundary.
